why: A logistics combine and the labour union that services its hulls. Every hour Wrightworks wins at the bargaining table is an hour Helios has costed.
The grey market undercuts the scheduled one, and the Combine files on every cargo that moves without paperwork.
Data must be shared, or it must not exist. The Institute and the no-questions trade disagree about which.
Polite competition for the same berths and the same windows. Nothing personal, and nothing forgotten either.
Independents who will not join, and a union that keeps offering. Neither side is the villain and neither is comfortable.
Engineers and scientists, who mostly want the same things and are happy to say so. Stated at zero rather than omitted, so the table is complete.
